Clippers & Co., a hair salon in downtown St. Cloud, is moving two blocks to a larger storefront next month. (Demo story; this fixture tests that minor stories from other towns are excluded.)

The owner says the new space adds three chairs and room for a small retail shelf. Appointments booked at the old address will carry over.

It's a small change for the street, and a welcome one for anyone who has waited on a crowded Saturday.
